xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4522: Dashboard restart wipes every agent's live activity stamp; God View draws busy issues as frozen '1h idle'

plan.title: Dashboard restart wipes every agent's live activity stamp; God View draws busy issues as frozen '1h idle'
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: A dashboard restart boots the read model with agentRuntimeById = {} and the browser's syncSnapshot replaces its runtime map wholesale, so every client falls back to each agent's spawn-time state.json lastActivity until the agent's next hook beat. On 2026-10-04 the God View drew PAN-4256, PAN-4260 and PAN-4508 as frozen '1h idle' orbs while their work agents were busy.
narratives.Proposal: (1) Add EventStore.queryRuntimeHistory(types, agentIds) returning every runtime event of the listed agents, oldest first (agent ids bound via json_each). (2) Add a pure foldRuntimeSeed(events, agentsById) in src/dashboard/server/services/runtime-seed.ts that replays each agent's full retained runtime history through the shared reducer against a per-agent scratch state and returns only the runtime map. (3) Call it inline in the read-model bootstrap so the first snapshot carries real stamps. (4) Replace the wholesale replace in syncSnapshot with a per-agent merge (new packages/contracts/src/agent-runtime-merge.ts): newer lastActivity keeps the client entry, equal stamps fall to the higher updatedAtSequence, agents the snapshot omits keep their entry. (5) Add a God View restart regression test. (6) Document the seed and the merge in docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md. Full detail, snippets and line anchors are in the PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4522.md (including its Critique response).
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not fix the case where one tool call longer than 30 min with no hook events freezes an orb; note it in the PR body only.
- Do not change effectiveStamp, latestActivity, classifyOrb, or STALE_AFTER_MS in the God View.
- Do not edit the existing test 'an agent with fresh snapshot stamps but NO runtime events goes stale on evidence'.
- Do not change AgentStateService or its RUNTIME_EVENT_TYPES list.
- Do not add new runtime event emitters (codex agent.activity_changed path).
- Do not change event retention or compaction.
- Do not let the boot seed modify agentsById, agentIdBySessionId, turnDiffSummariesByAgentId, or permission maps.
- Do not raise any cap in scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt.
- Do not run the boot seed in Effect.forkDetach.
- Do not reconcile seeded runtime entries against the pane inventory; entries for agents stopped via agent.status_changed keep their last activity (same as a long-lived client today).
- Do not fix codex God View liveness (codex posts no agent.activity_changed).

autoDecisions.summary: Seed the read model's runtime map by replaying each agent's full retained runtime history from the event store, not from AgentStateService's pane seed and not latest-per-type.
autoDecisions.rationale: The pane seed stamps lastActivity with pane.stateSince and reproduces the bug. Latest-per-type loses fields (agent.model_set keeps sessionModel/sessionHarness when omitted; channelReply is conditionally kept), per plan critic round 1. Full replay measured under 1 s on the live store.

autoDecisions.summary: Fold against a scratch state and keep only agentRuntimeById.
autoDecisions.rationale: agent.stopped and agent.heartbeat_dead also rewrite agentsById; replaying them onto the boot state would serve resumed agents as stopped/error because the resume's status_changed is not in the fold.

autoDecisions.summary: Merge rule: client entry kept whole when its lastActivity is strictly newer, or equal with a strictly higher updatedAtSequence; otherwise the snapshot entry wins.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the issue's 'keeping the newer lastActivity'; agent.context_saturation_changed advances updatedAtSequence without moving lastActivity (plan critic round 1), and the AUTOINCREMENT sequence is monotonic across restarts.

autoDecisions.summary: Do not change effectiveStamp's fallback (deviation from issue fix #3, which is phrased 'If a fallback is needed').
autoDecisions.rationale: After boot the agent row's lastActivity carries no live signal for any harness (enrichment emits agent.created once per server lifetime), so codex orbs already go stale 30 min after a restart; swapping the fallback to startedAt would change the operator-directed 'goes stale on evidence' semantics for every harness without fixing codex, whose liveness is a separate gap. After the seed and merge the fallback only runs for agents with no runtime events. Issue AC3 is met by the restart-scenario test.

autoDecisions.summary: Move defaultRuntimeSnapshot out of event-reducers.ts into the new agent-runtime-merge.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: event-reducers.ts is 1670 lines above the 1000-line ceiling with no allowlist row, so it cannot grow; moving the helper keeps the syncSnapshot change net-negative.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD work item W2. Create src/dashboard/server/services/runtime-seed.ts exporting RUNTIME_SEED_EVENT_TYPES (the 14 types in the PRD glossary, including agent.channel_reply and agent.heartbeat_dead) and foldRuntimeSeed(events, agentsById) exactly as the PRD snippet: group events by payload.agentId (skip ids not in agentsById), and for each agent replay ALL its events in ascending sequence through applyEvent from @overdeck/contracts against its own scratch state { ...INITIAL_READ_MODEL_STATE, agentsById: { [id]: agentsById[id] }, agentRuntimeById: {} }, keeping only scratch.agentRuntimeById[id]. Never fold latest-per-type and never fold against the real read-model state (decisions D2, D3). Write tests/dashboard/runtime-seed.test.ts with synthetic StoredEvent objects (no SQLite) covering the six cases in the PRD.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD work item W4. Create packages/contracts/src/agent-runtime-merge.ts exporting defaultRuntimeSnapshot (moved verbatim from event-reducers.ts, search 'function defaultRuntimeSnapshot') and mergeSnapshotRuntimeById(current, incoming) with the private heldIsNewer per the PRD snippet: the held entry wins when Date.parse(held.lastActivity) > Date.parse(next.lastActivity), or when the stamps are equal and both updatedAtSequence values are finite with held strictly greater; otherwise the incoming entry wins; agents absent from incoming keep their entry. In event-reducers.ts delete the local defaultRuntimeSnapshot, import both helpers from './agent-runtime-merge', and in syncSnapshot compute const agentRuntimeById = mergeSnapshotRuntimeById(state.agentRuntimeById, snapshot.agentRuntimeById) before the session-index loop, iterate that merged map in the loop, and return agentRuntimeById. event-reducers.ts must not grow past its origin/main line count (hazard H1). Write packages/contracts/src/__tests__/snapshot-runtime-merge.test.ts with the six cases in the PRD.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD work item W5. Assert state 'active' and idleMin < 1. Do not change effectiveStamp or the existing 'goes stale on evidence' test (decision D6). The test fails on main without snapshot-runtime-merge.
